input.query: SELECT decision_date, platform, doc_type, SUM(n_decisions) decisions, SUM(n_approved) approved, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE/NULLIF(SUM(n_decisions),0) approval_rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform='ios' AND doc_type='driving_licence' AND decision_date >= DATE '2026-03-15' AND decision_date < DATE '2026-04-27' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', event_date)::DATE week_start, app_version, COUNT(*) attempts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_kyc_approved) approved, AVG(CASE WHEN is_kyc_approved THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) approval_rate FROM fct_kyc_attempts WHERE platform='ios' AND doc_type='driving_licence' AND event_date >= DATE '2026-03-30' AND event_date < DATE '2026-04-27' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT month, reject_reason, SUM(n_rejections) n_rejections FROM agg_kyc_reject_reasons_monthly WHERE platform='ios' AND doc_type='driving_licence' AND month >= TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01' AND month < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,3 DESC
